**Taking time to build**

I’m still building and need a bit more time, so I think I'll wait around 60 seconds. My overall wall-clock budget is 1800 seconds, though, so that's plenty of time. I plan to check back every 30 seconds to see if the listening line is ready. It seems like a good strategy to keep things moving while still allowing for the necessary time to get everything set up properly!
